headline: DPW update on city accessibility issues, with 2027 event planning on the agenda.
summary: The agenda also lists the Treasurer's Report, the ADA Coordinator's report, and recent See Click Fix reports. Officer nominations are on the agenda as a reminder under old business.
items: ADA Coordinator's report and recent See Click Fix reports
Update from DPW on accessibility issues in the city
Old business: reminder about commission officer nominations
New business: event calendar and planning for 2027
Awareness spotlight for December, presented by Brad
Other business for the good and welfare of the community, including people with disabilities
location: Great Hall, Searles Building, 41 Pleasant Street, Methuen
plain_text:
The City of Methuen is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer in its Programs and Activities  
City of Methuen, Massachusetts 
Commission on Disability 
The Searles Building, 41 Pleasant Street, Suite 306 
Methuen, Massachusetts 01844 
 
 
David P. Beauregard, Jr 
Mayor 
Brad J. Gosselin 
MCOD Chairman 
PUBLIC MEETING NOTICE 
Notice is hereby given that the Methuen Commission 
on Disability will hold its next meeting on:  
December 3rd, 2026 
Methuen City Hall, 7:00 p.m. 
Searles Building- 41 Pleasant Street Methuen in the Great Hall 
 
AGENDA 
 
 
1) Call to Order, Attendance & Approval of Agenda 
2) Approval of the Minutes from the last meeting 
3) Public Participation- maximum time 5 minutes 
4) Treasurer’s Report 
5) ADA Coordinator’s Report and recent See Click Fix reports 
6) Update from DPW on accessibility issues in the city 
 
7) Old Business 
 
- Commission Officer Nominations reminder 
. 
 
8) New Business 
 
- Event Calendar and planning for 2027 
 
 
 
Any other business for the Good and Welfare of the community including individuals with a disability. 
Awareness Spotlight – December - Brad  
Adjournment 
Accessibility Notice: Anyone needing access to accommodation to participate in City of Methuen programs or 
services, please contact Deputy DPW Director Felix Garcia, ADA Coordinator, at 978-983-8545 or 
fgarcia@methuen.gov at least 2 weeks in advance, or 2 business days before any Board or Commission meeting. 
This notice is available in alternative formats upon request.
